destination.name: Ningbo
destination.tagline: A historic Zhejiang port city of old libraries, Chan temples and a revived riverfront
destination.description: Ningbo is a major port on the Yong River with more than a thousand years of trading history. Its old quarter holds Tianyi Pavilion, one of China's oldest private libraries, and the Old Bund, a riverside district with a Catholic cathedral. Chan Buddhist temples such as Tiantong and Temple of King Ashoka sit in the hills of Yinzhou, and Moon Lake and the Wang Shu-designed art museum give the city modern, waterside corners.

goodToKnow.title: Use the metro
goodToKnow.detail: Sights are spread across Yinzhou, Jiangbei and Zhenhai. The metro and taxis cover most of them, so group stops by district.

goodToKnow.title: Temples are far out
goodToKnow.detail: Tiantong and King Ashoka temples lie in the hills east of the centre. Allow half a day for the pair and go early.

goodToKnow.title: Pack for plum rains
goodToKnow.detail: June brings long spells of rain and high humidity, and typhoons can pass through in August and September.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Ningbo is most comfortable in {months}, when the air is mild and dry and the plum rains and typhoons are away.
